what_they_do.value: Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale.

priorities.priority: Help customers observe, secure, and act on AI-enabled solutions.
priorities.evidence: CEO Olivier Pomel said customers are building and deploying with AI and using Datadog to observe, secure, and act on those solutions.

priorities.priority: Build autonomy into operations through AI agents and automated incident response.
priorities.evidence: Datadog launched more than 100 capabilities at DASH 2026, including fully autonomous Bits AI for end-to-end incident detection, investigation, and remediation, plus Bits Agent Builder for custom AI agents.

priorities.priority: Invest in AI research and agentic LLM post-training.
priorities.evidence: Datadog acquired Adaptive ML to accelerate AI Research investment in world models and agentic LLM post-training for observability.

priorities.priority: Expand adoption among larger enterprise customers.
priorities.evidence: Datadog reported about 4,720 customers with $100,000 or more in ARR as of June 30, 2026, up 23% from about 3,850 a year earlier.

priorities.priority: Strengthen AI and cloud security while supporting customer-controlled deployment.
priorities.evidence: DASH capabilities included AI Guard to protect agents from prompt injection and poisoning attacks, and Bring Your Own Cloud for deploying Datadog within customer environments.

challenges.challenge: Managing rising technology complexity while customers increasingly expect autonomous operations.
challenges.evidence: Pomel said Datadog is innovating rapidly to help customers manage rising complexity and increasingly build autonomy into operations.

challenges.challenge: Securing AI agents against new attack modes such as prompt injection and poisoning.
challenges.evidence: The company highlighted AI Guard specifically to protect AI agents from prompt injection and poisoning attacks, indicating an active security problem around AI adoption.

challenges.challenge: Operating in a highly competitive, rapidly changing market while adapting to changing privacy and security obligations.
challenges.evidence: Datadog's release identifies competitive markets, rapidly changing technology and customer needs, and changing laws, regulations, and contractual obligations related to data privacy and security as business risks.

challenges.challenge: Sustaining growth through customer expansion, renewals, and new-customer acquisition.
challenges.evidence: Datadog identifies dependence on existing customers purchasing additional subscriptions and products and renewing, as well as its ability to attract new customers, as risks.

recent_changes.headline: Datadog scheduled its Q3 fiscal 2026 earnings call for November 4, 2026.
recent_changes.summary: The company announced it will report third-quarter results before U.S. markets open on November 4 and host a conference call afterward.

recent_changes.headline: Datadog acquired Adaptive ML.
recent_changes.summary: The acquisition is intended to accelerate Datadog AI Research's work on world models and agentic LLM post-training for observability.

recent_changes.headline: Datadog announced more than 100 new capabilities at DASH 2026.
recent_changes.summary: Highlights included autonomous Bits AI, AI Guard, Bring Your Own Cloud, and Bits Agent Builder; the release also says Bits Code, Bits Chat, and Bits Agent Builder reached general availability.

key_people.name: Olivier Pomel
key_people.title: CEO & Co-Founder
key_people.recent: On August 6, 2026, he said customers are using Datadog to observe, secure, and act on AI-enabled solutions, and that the company is helping customers manage rising complexity and build autonomy.

talking_points: As Datadog moves from AI visibility toward autonomous detection, investigation, and remediation, which operational workflows are the highest priority to automate next?
How is the team balancing rapid AI-agent adoption with the security and governance requirements highlighted by AI Guard and Bring Your Own Cloud?
With Adaptive ML and more than 100 DASH capabilities now in the portfolio, where does Datadog most need help scaling adoption across larger enterprise customers?
